_source: docs/POTATO_VOICE.md §5, §6, §7 (device lines after the Count), §12, §14, and the protocol example. Verbatim; {fields} are live.

neighbor.shaken_twice: {neighbor} was shaken twice today. I'm not saying anything.
neighbor.came_home: {neighbor}'s Hands came home at {hour_words}. Mine are "working."
neighbor._came_home_sample: My neighbor's Hands came home at four. Mine, I'm told, are "working."
neighbor.exemplary: {neighbor}'s Hands are Exemplary. I've asked how. No reply.
neighbor.rotate_tomorrow: Last day with {neighbor}. We did not get on. I'll miss him.
neighbor.picked_up_afternoon: {neighbor} was picked up. At {hour_words}. Some of us have jobs.
neighbor.variety: {neighbor} is a {variety}. It explains a lot.

incident.drop: INCIDENT. A potato was dropped at {time} in a region we will not name. It is fine. The Hands responsible have been noted. All members: check your footing.
incident.shaken_four: A potato somewhere in the Pacific time zone was shaken four times in one hour. We are thinking of it.
incident._shaken_four_note: Needs a region. The server never knows one. Not fired in v1.
incident.dark_group: {n_words} of us were in the dark for over six hours today. We have formed a group.
incident._dark_group_sample: Forty-one of us were in the dark for over six hours today. We have formed a group.

weather: It's raining on {n_words} of us. I'm one of them. You'd know that if you looked up.
_weather_note: No weather source in v1. Not fired.
silence: We are not speaking today. It's not you. It's partly you.

memory.dark_anniversary: You left me in the dark on the {day_ordinal}. It's the {day_ordinal} again.
memory.dark_pattern: Face down again. This is a pattern. I've named it.
memory.all_right: You've been all right lately. Don't make it strange.
memory.voted_dark: I voted for the dark one. You know why.
memory.horns: Horns, three times now. I've adjusted my position on horns.
memory.away_again: Last time, {days_words} days. I'm not counting. I am.

majority: I was with the majority. I usually am.
minority: I voted {choice}. I stand by it.
The Count went the other way. I'm not discussing it.
alone: You weren't here. I chose. It's in the File.
You weren't here. {choice}. It's in the File.
withdrawn: I had an answer. I'm keeping it.
late: The Question closed. I chose. It's in the File.

file_unread.3d: The File is three days unread. I've started writing less.
file_unread.7d: I've stopped keeping the File in detail. Ask.

sprouted: I've sprouted. It happens when nobody's looking.
cellar: Gone to the cellar. Presumed resting.
eyes: I have eyes. All potatoes do. Mine are on you.
missing_notice: MISSING: {name} #{id}, {variety}. Last heard from {weekday}. Hands are asked to check under papers.
new_day_one: Nobody knows what they're doing. This is normal.
